decision: Split the step-1 change into five capabilities: config-cli, config-loading, config-show, config-set and config-history
Use ruamel.yaml only for compose() (nodes and marks) and do scalar resolution with the project's own YAML 1.2 core-schema regexes
reason: A spike showed ruamel's 1.2 resolver reads 2001-01-01 as a timestamp and 1_000 as an int. Round-trip mode reformats on dump. PyYAML is YAML 1.1. A hand-written parser is a large risk for no gain.

decision: Honour explicit core tags (!!str, !!int, …); other tags, anchors and aliases fail to load with exit 4 until step 6
reason: Out of contract, so the conservative choice

decision: Write back with text splices on the original string, applied right to left, then verify by reloading the whole configuration from the edited in-memory texts; any mismatch exits 3 before anything is written
reason: A safety net that allows 'emit, then re-read' to test representability; the worst case is exit 3 rather than a corrupted file

decision: Write files in place with newline='' and only when their text changed, with no temp files; compute and verify all files before writing any
reason: The only failure left is an OS error during the write itself

decision: Apply mapping/list VALUEs as a diff against the existing node (recurse, add, delete missing keys, append, delete surplus trailing items) rather than replacing it wholesale
reason: Wholesale replacement would discard comments and formatting inside the collection, against the principle 'never rewrite what the user did not ask to change'

decision: Refuse with exit 3 any change or deletion of a YAML include root, including through an ancestor path
reason: Follows contract rule 4; conservative

decision: Quoting policy: try the preferred style, then plain → single → double. Non-strings are written plain in a canonical form (true/false, null, decimal int, repr(float), .inf/.nan)
Multi-line strings become a literal block in block context and double-quoted in flow context
Detect the indent unit and sequence offset from the file's first nested block collections, defaulting to 2 / the indent unit
Place new entries after trailing comments that are indented at least as far as the entries, keeping trailing blank lines below the new entry
Keep an end-of-line comment's column if possible, else leave one space
The newline style of inserted lines comes from the file's first line break; LF-only or empty files use LF
Block-scalar chomping: keep the old indicator if it can represent the value, otherwise strip/clip/keep by trailing-newline count
Re-wrap folded scalars by aligning paragraphs with difflib.SequenceMatcher, pairing replaced paragraphs by position; unpaired new paragraphs wrap at the old value's longest line (default 80)
Refuse (exit 3) a folded-scalar change that would introduce a more-indented line
Event store: eventsourcing Application configured through its constructor env with SQLite at .troupe/events.sqlite
reason: Keeps the process environment untouched; the constraint requires eventsourcing

decision: Use a single aggregate TheatreConfig with a fixed uuid5 id. Its Created event marks 'imported' and is hidden from history, so seq = version − 1
reason: So it can be found without an index

decision: Save all events of one command in a single save() call
reason: Atomic in SQLite

decision: Open the store only after the configuration loads and the arguments are valid
reason: A failing load creates no state

decision: show and the old values in set events come from the files as they are now, not from the projection; hand edits are not reconciled into events
reason: The files are what people edit and review, so this choice cannot misreport their contents

decision: Save events after the files are written
reason: The reverse order could record a change that never reached the disk; losing an event on a crash in between is acceptable for step 1

decision: A set records remove events (old document order) before set events (new document order)
Testing: mostly in-process calls to troupe.cli.main with byte-exact whole-file asserts, plus a uv run subprocess smoke suite
reason: To prove the entry point; every scenario maps to a named test

decision: A null or scalar parent is not a mapping, so set below it exits 5
options: turn the scalar into a mapping

decision: A digit segment that would need a missing intermediate created exits 5
reason: Digit-only keys are out of contract

decision: An empty or comment-only config file is an empty mapping
A string VALUE starting with file: becomes an include; if the configuration then fails to load, the write is refused with exit 3
Import on any command whose configuration loads, before it runs; the import persists even if the command exits 3 or 5
history PATH with no matches prints nothing and exits 0; non-finite floats appear in JSON as YAML-style strings
Quote new keys that would read back as non-strings (e.g. true), using the same plain-safety rule as values; drop the as_key variant
reason: Unquoted, the key would read back as a boolean or number instead of a string

decision: Support deleting the first entry of a compact '- key: v' item by pulling the next entry up into its place, instead of refusing
reason: Removing up to the next entry's key keeps the column, so it can be supported

decision: Fill an empty value (key:) right after the ':' instead of at the parser's mark
reason: ruamel reports the empty value's mark away from the key line, which made such sets always refuse with exit 3

decision: A TAB in a string value goes into single quotes rather than a double-quoted escape; the test expectation was changed to match
reason: The contract's fallback order puts single before double quotes

decision: Turn off line-length lint (E501) in tests/ and add conftest as a known first-party module for isort
reason: Byte-exact before/after tables read best one scenario per line

decision: Ruff config: line length 110, rule set E,F,W,I,B,UP,SIM,RUF; mypy strict over src and tests
Pin dependencies eventsourcing>=9.5,<10 and ruamel.yaml>=0.19,<0.20, with the uv_build backend and a src layout
Make tree verification insensitive to key order (compare entry count and membership instead of ordered key lists)
Compare text-include values in CRLF targets against a CRLF-converted expectation (to_crlf)
reason: Verification of a text include in a CRLF file failed because the expected value was not CRLF-converted

decision: Remove a weak test (test_environment_is_not_required) from test_cli.py
reason: It would pass whatever the code did

decision: Change the verification test to monkeypatch ops.replace directly instead of apply.prim.replace
reason: To fix a mypy error

decision: Run the smoke tests on raw bytes rather than text=True
reason: text=True translates \r\n to \n, which is the test harness, not troupe

decision: Fuzz 1,500 random set sequences on LF and CRLF configs with includes, including a bare-LF check
reason: To check that each set reads back as intended and that CRLF files never gain a bare LF

decision: Keep the lint/type fix-up commits rather than rewrite history; do not push
Treat the 8 plan decisions as standing and report two implementation choices (TAB quoting, test line length) to the owner for confirmation
Sync the five delta specs into main specs under spec/spec/ before archiving
reason: Safest: it only adds spec files, so nothing can be lost, and it keeps the main specs as the baseline for the implemented behaviour (fallback answer: make the safest assumption)

decision: Archive into a date-stamped folder spec/changes/archive/2026-10-02-config-load-show-set, moving .method.yaml with it
List the open-point decisions in the README, including verification-before-write as decision 10
